description: Two armoured horsemen clash side by side in a muddy field. Both wear mail hauberks and kettle-style helmets; the rider on the left grips a long wooden lance, and its shaft is splintering against a round shield held by the rider on the right, with wood fragments flying. The rider on the right reaches out with his free arm. Behind them a crowd of soldiers with shields and spears stands among tents under a dark, stormy sky. There is no visible text, frame or border, and no blood or wounds.
